[[Crew chief/Legends|Crew Chief]] '''Soskar Renn''' was a [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] who worked with a crew during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Second Battle of Coruscant|invasion]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Renn led two scavenger squads to strip components off a New Republic [[Transport/Legends|transport]].
